items.title: Scaling real-time bidding and publisher monetization with the AWS Video Streaming Advertising Lens
items.summary: At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we’re excited to announce our next evolution of the AWS Well-Architected Video Streaming Advertising (VSA) Lens. A Well-Architected Lens extends the AWS Well-Architected Framework with industry-specific or technology-specific guidance. The VSA Lens provides architectural best practices specifically for video streaming advertising workloads. The lens consists of a VSA whitepaper and a custom lens, available to the public on the AWS Well-Architected custom lens GitHub repository
items.creator: Abraham Lobo
